inputs.text: Health workers in Nigeria are taking a courageous stand for labor rights and against entrenched inequality by protesting reforms that would only bolster institutional power at the expense of those delivering essential care. On Thursday, the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations gathered at the Unity Fountain in Maitama in Abuja to oppose reform bills before the National Assembly. These actions reflect a broader fight by frontline workers against policies that perpetuate structural neglect in the health sector, where vulnerable communities already bear the brunt of underfunded and inequitable services. Far from undermining stability, this resistance challenges self-serving efforts to weaken unions and sideline the needs of ordinary people in favor of top-down control.
